mapper.sql: id, standard_name, gender, age_min, age_max, activity_level, target_goal, daily_calories, protein_grams, fat_grams, carbs_grams, water_ml, status, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nutrition_standard WHERE status = 10 AND deleted = 0 AND (gender = 0 OR gender = #{gender}) AND (age_min IS NULL OR #{age} >= age_min) AND (age_max IS NULL OR #{age} <= age_max) AND (activity_level IS NULL OR activity_level = #{activityLevel}) AND target_goal = #{targetGoal} ORDER BY gender DESC LIMIT 1
